evidence_sentence: The function also includes error handling for out-of-range block numbers and manages reference counting for buffers.
rationale: The fixed implementation alone computes the end-of-filesystem bound and returns NULL after reporting an alert when blkno is out of range. The vulnerable implementation has no out-of-range block-number check or corresponding error path. Reference-count handling is present in both versions, but the combined sentence explicitly asserts the fixed-only range-error behavior.
rewritten_docstring: The function calculates the total number of bytes to search for and checks for alignment and corruption. It traverses a red-black tree of buffers to find a matching block number. If a match is found, it handles stale buffers and locks the buffer. If no match is found, it may insert a new buffer into the tree. The function manages reference counting for buffers.
